definition.def: A summary of something is a short account of it, which gives the main points but not the details.
examples: What follows is a brief summary of the process. [+ of]
Here's a summary of the day's news. [+ of]
Milligan gives a fair summary of his subject within a relatively short space.

definition.def: You use in summary to indicate that what you are about to say is a summary of what has just been said.
examples: In summary, it is my opinion that this complete treatment process was very successful.

definition.def: Summary actions are done without delay, often when something else should have been done first or done instead. [formal]
examples: It says torture and summary execution are common.
There is no doubt that some considered that a beating was no more than summary justice.
The four men were killed after a summary trial.
